data.pageTitle: About Graziano Casto | Developer Advocate @ Akuity, Co-Chair CNCF TAG DevEx
data.pageDescription: Graziano Casto, Developer Advocate at Akuity (Argo CD, Kargo). Making cloud native continuous delivery easier. Co-Chair of CNCF TAG Developer Experience.

mainEntity.name: Graziano Casto
mainEntity.description: Developer Advocate at Akuity (Argo CD, Kargo). Co-Chair of the CNCF TAG Developer Experience, Kubernetes Blog Maintainer, KEP Wrangler for SIG Node, and Platform Engineering Ambassador.

mainEntity.name: What is Graziano Casto's role at CNCF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graziano Casto is Co-Chair of the CNCF TAG Developer Experience, where he defines strategic direction and ensures initiatives align with the CNCF TOC. He was elected Co-Chair after serving as Tech Lead, where he led the State of AI-Assisted Development initiative. He also serves as KEP Wrangler for SIG Node and Kubernetes Blog Maintainer.

mainEntity.name: What topics does Graziano Casto speak about?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graziano speaks about Cloud Native technologies, Kubernetes, GitOps, continuous delivery, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience, and DevOps practices. He focuses on practical implementations and real-world case studies.

Graziano has spoken at KubeCon, CNCF events, WeAreDevelopers, Open Source Day, and 50+ international conferences across Europe and online. He presents at both in-person events in Italy and globally, and at virtual meetups and conferences worldwide.

Graziano is a former distributed systems developer and product manager, now working as Developer Advocate at Akuity (Argo CD, Kargo). He holds a Computer Science Bachelor's degree from Politecnico di Milano and has been active in the Kubernetes and CNCF open source community since 2024.
